_comment: LuCI shows a grey signal icon and 'No client associated' for an access
point whose driver reports no client RSSI (UWE5622 in AP mode), and a full
icon for each client by accident. opiz3-luci-nosig applies these edits to the
minified LuCI 25.12 views: an AP with clients gets an 'on' icon and its client
count, a client without RSSI a neutral icon and '---', both with a tooltip
saying the driver does not report it. A file is changed only if every anchor
is found exactly once; the CI checks the anchors against the built image.
